reader_summary.overview: "All of a sudden you can program the world" -- it's the continuation of the software eating the world thesis we put out over five years ago. What tech trends and platforms do we find most interesting on the heels of raising our fifth fund? Are we just building on and extending existing platforms though, or will there be new platforms; and if so, what will they be?

key_points.text: "All of a sudden you can program the world" -- it's the continuation of the software eating the world thesis we put out over five years ago.
This episode of the a16z Podcast covers all things distributed systems -- encompassing cloud and SaaS; A.I., machine learning, deep learning.
